title: Applied Statistics: Time Series
text:
Course organization
Day and time: Variable throughout the semester.
Online material: All material will be made available from this webpage.
First exam: Novemver 10, 2026: Brief exam (most likely QCM), approx. 45 minutes.
Second exam: January 19, 2027: Longer exam with hands on, approx. 90 minutes.
Course wiki: A course wiki will be set up. The idea is that you ceate your own list of important concepts. You fill it, I check it.

22.9.26: Recap of statistics

8.10.26: Recap on vectorial geometry
15.10.26: Fourier 1/2
20.10.26: Fourier 2/2

9.11.26: Recap and mock exam
